visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor car interior, close-up on a yoke-style steering wheel. A man with short black hair wearing a black jacket sits in the driver's seat. He gestures with his hand toward the dashboard. Lighting is dim, typical of an indoor parking garage. (2) The steering wheel moves automatically. The dashboard screen shows a self-parking visualization. The man watches the screen, his expression shifting from anticipation to skepticism. (3) Close-up on the large center console screen, which displays live camera feeds from the rear and sides of the vehicle as it attempts to park. (4) The man turns his head toward the camera, looking amused and slightly disappointed. He remains hands-off as the car continues its maneuver. (5) The dashboard screen displays a red warning icon of a steering wheel with text instructions. The man sighs and looks back at the road.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The interior of a Tesla car equipped with a yoke steering wheel and a large center touchscreen. Outside the windows, an indoor parking garage with concrete pillars and other parked cars is visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks at a fast, excited pace over a soft, ambient synthesizer background. He mentions the cost of a car feature. (2) A rhythmic, high-pitched 'beep-beep' alert sound from the car's sensors begins. The speaker reacts with 'Woah' sounds synced to the beeps. (3) The speaker's tone shifts to a questioning and slightly mocking delivery as the sensor beeps become faster and more urgent. (4) A rapid, continuous alert chime ('bi-bi-bi-bi') takes over the audio. The speaker laughs while explaining the car's indecision. (5) The alerts stop. The speaker sighs deeply and concludes with a humorous, resigned comment about the car's request for manual intervention.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously demonstrate the limitations of Tesla's expensive self-parking feature by showing it fail in a real-world parking scenario, emphasizing the irony of its high price versus performance.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The tone is critical and satirical regarding the product's performance.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses synchronized sensor beeps and close-up shots of screens to build tension before the comedic 'failure' of the technology.
